By combining interactive mapping, territorial indicators, satellite-derived data, and an AI assistant, the platform transforms complex scientific information into actionable insights for decision-makers.

details:
Detailed Project Description

ArtisanConnect Geo Intelligence is an AI-powered geospatial platform designed to help local authorities understand, monitor, and anticipate territorial changes using NASA Earth observation data.

The platform integrates satellite-derived environmental indicators, interactive mapping technologies, and artificial intelligence to transform complex scientific datasets into actionable insights for decision-makers.

Users can explore territorial indicators through an interactive dashboard, visualize trends over time, identify significant changes, and receive AI-generated explanations and recommendations tailored to local contexts.

Our MVP includes an interactive map, NASA data integration capabilities, territorial indicators, an AI assistant, and a recommendation engine. These components work together to simplify the interpretation of Earth system data and improve decision-making processes.

The project aims to support urban planning, environmental monitoring, climate adaptation, disaster preparedness, and sustainable development initiatives.

Technologies used include React, JavaScript, REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, geospatial visualization tools, and AI-powered analysis capabilities.

The innovative aspect of the project lies in combining NASA Earth observation resources with artificial intelligence and user-friendly interfaces to make scientific information accessible to local governments and communities.

Our team considered accessibility, scalability, usability, transparency of recommendations, and the practical needs of municipal decision-makers during the design process.
